last_result.headline: Q10: the alignment line finally beats the flat anchor under nested selection - TWH=1 emission gives nested DP 12.170 vs flat 12.722, both folds agreeing, against TWH=8 13.206 and N1 13.644; lam=60 verified as an interior optimum after extending the grid to 800. But NOT submittable: the gate is an AND and 12.170 vs deployed ~8.86 is ~37% worse, the win is tail-driven (helps 16-17 of 40 wells), and the 0.28-0.55 margin is grid-sensitive. Revises N1 - the emission was NOT saturated (+0.030 AUC bought -1.04 RMSE), so "the gap is wholly in the transition model" is withdrawn; N1 amended in place.
